body:
## Summary

Research audit; no new κ. PR799's proof note says its four paired read exchanges give ideal κ gains that are "exactly additive". The child-profile changes add exactly, but solving the moment equation makes the ideal gains strictly convex in the number of exchanges.

```text
16 subsets of the four paired exchanges
  -> 5 exact child profiles
  -> 2 retained rational moment engines
  -> positive second differences of ideal κ
```

The exact certificate proves

```text
8.4541370845e-11 < κ4 - 4κ1 + 3κ0 < 8.4541370846e-11.
```

An independent analytic argument proves strict convexity for the full real interpolation between zero and four exchanges. The existing verifier prices the complete final profile, so the selected conditional κ remains `0.001661634653669567`.

Only `research/x4-gain-additivity-audit/` is added. It includes a proof, corrected wording, source pins, deterministic receipt and mutation controls. Frozen sources and their manifests are preserved.

## Evidence

- Before: `research/gauge44-frames-x/PROOF-NOTE-FRAMES-X4.md` describes the ideal gains as exactly additive.
- After: all 16 subsets preserve the retained builder's B scalar map, frames, endpoints and helper widths. Both rational engines certify five root brackets; all three consecutive ideal-κ second differences are positive. A proposed linearly added gain fails the exact sign check.

```sh
python3 -B -I research/x4-gain-additivity-audit/verify.py --check research/x4-gain-additivity-audit/RESULT.json
python3 -B -I research/x4-gain-additivity-audit/test_audit.py
make selected-record-check
```

The saved receipt matches, all five tests pass, and selected-record integrity passes. Tests include isolated optimized Python and three mutation controls. The existing PR799 independent price replay also passes with its original κ and all 47 outer constraints. `VALIDATION.json` records the checks. The repository-wide suite and complete cold replay were not rerun for this standalone audit.

Base: `f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`. Seed 61, adversarial mathematical audit. `CLAIM.json` records the alternatives and overlap check. Intermediate subset checks are not complete native/global admission, and the real interpolation does not assert fractional physical circuits. Inherited all-size, realization, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain.

Credit Jeremy Kothe's PR799, Chafik Boukhalfa's PR741, and the retained SW4 and rational-engine contributors. Prepared for @AmnonTamsut with substantial OpenAI GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6 Sol assistance. Apache-2.0. This is AI-assisted review, not independent human peer review or a full multiplication theorem proof.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. Removing the new audit directory reverts the change.

**Blast Radius:** isolated. No selected construction, production verifier, generator or source manifest changes.
title: Research audit: X4 profile changes add, ideal exponent gains do not (no new kappa)
